# Pinned versions

This file records the toolchain that reproduced the audited scenarios.
It is a historical reproduction.
It is not a support policy, and it does not promise that these versions stay supported.

| pnpm | 10.19.0 | `package.json:45` |
| TypeScript | 5.9.3 | `pnpm-lock.yaml:4380` |
| Vitest | 4.0.17 | `pnpm-lock.yaml:4603` |
| esbuild | 0.27.2 | `pnpm-lock.yaml:2731` |
| Rollup | 4.55.2 | `pnpm-lock.yaml:3962` |
